# agent-mcp-router-mcp

> Agent MCP Router MCP — one router for the whole MEOK fleet. Holds 62 MEOK MCPs behind one namespaced endpoint. Install ONE thing, get all of them. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- list_routes
- route_call
- register_local_mcp
- health_check
- bundle_subset
- sign_call_chain

## Install
```
pip install agent-mcp-router-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/agent-mcp-router-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
